Hello! My name is Dr. Bruce Watson, but you can call me Bruce. I would like to help you even when you are not getting adjusted in my office by sharing tips, advice, and insights on health and wellness. In the short time my new clinic has opened, we are already being recognized as the highest referred and reviewed chiropractic clinic Manteca has to offer as well as "Best of 209." This channel will address some of the best advice I come across regarding diet, exercise, chiropractic care, and more. I look forward to connecting with you! - Bruce
